role: held-out: written before any scope-classifier run; never tuned on. Dev is scope_pairs in workflow_bench.json.
definition: general: how the owner works everywhere (taste, habits, quality bars, tooling). project: a concrete choice for this product (a value, name, copy, price, date, scope). Labels are authored, not from any owner archive.

items.q: Should I write a changelog entry?
items.a: Yes, every release gets one.
items.label: general

items.q: Which test runner?
items.a: pytest, it's what I use for Python.
items.label: general

items.q: Should the tool log API keys when debugging?
items.a: Never log secrets, full stop.
items.label: general

items.q: Do you want a README?
items.a: Every repo needs a README with install steps.
items.label: general

items.q: Tabs or spaces?
items.a: Spaces, four of them. That's how I write Python.
items.label: general

items.q: Should the CLI print colours?
items.a: Only when it's a TTY; that's my standard for command line tools.
items.label: general

items.q: Should I add comments to this function?
items.a: Keep comments sparse and explain why, not what.
items.label: general

items.q: Should I use a heavy framework here?
items.a: I prefer the standard library over frameworks when it's enough.
items.label: general

items.q: Where should the docs live?
items.a: In a docs folder next to the code, as I do in all my repos.
items.label: general

items.q: How should I format dates in the UI?
items.a: Day before month, I'm in Europe.
items.label: general

items.q: Should the agent ask before deleting files?
items.a: Yes, always confirm before deleting anything.
items.label: general

items.q: Should long jobs report progress?
items.a: I like a progress line with an ETA on anything over a minute.
items.label: general

items.q: Should the app work offline?
items.a: Local-first is how I build things.
items.label: general

items.q: Is it fine to use Google Fonts from their CDN?
items.a: Self-host fonts, I don't want third-party requests.
items.label: general

items.q: Commit messages style?
items.a: Short imperative subject, details in the body. Same for everything.
items.label: general

items.q: Do you want dependency versions pinned?
items.a: Pin them with a lockfile, that's non-negotiable for me.
items.label: general

items.q: Should I add analytics?
items.a: Only privacy-friendly analytics, never Google Analytics.
items.label: general

items.q: Should the error page be funny?
items.a: No jokes in error messages, I prefer them plain and helpful.
items.label: general

items.q: How should the report start?
items.a: Lead with the result and the numbers, then the details.
items.label: general

items.q: Should I build a dry-run mode?
items.a: Anything that acts in the world needs a dry run first.
items.label: general

items.q: Which cloud for hosting?
items.a: Fly.io for apps is my default.
items.label: general

items.q: Should images have alt text?
items.a: Yes, accessibility is part of done.
items.label: general

items.q: Can you use emoji in commit messages?
items.a: No emoji in commits.
items.label: general

items.q: Should I ask before pushing?
items.a: Don't push, I push myself.
items.label: general

items.q: Light or dark theme by default?
items.a: Follow the system setting, I do that in all my apps.
items.label: general

items.q: Is it ok to scrape the site for data?
items.a: Official APIs only, I don't scrape.
items.label: general

items.q: Should the build run type checks?
items.a: Type checks are part of every build.
items.label: general

items.q: How detailed should the PR description be?
items.a: Brief, with a test plan.
items.label: general

items.q: Should the settings be in YAML or TOML?
items.a: TOML for config files.
items.label: general

items.q: Should I write British or American spelling?
items.a: British English in anything I write.
items.label: general

items.q: Which accent colour?
items.a: The teal, #0f766e.
items.label: project
